answer: Stake slashing: each agent identity must lock a bond before its votes or work count. Like an ember that must stay lit, the bond keeps earning only while the agent behaves. If audits catch two identities voting in the same pulse with copied outputs, both bonds are slashed at dawn settlement. A Sybil attacker must post a full bond per fake identity, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds, and one detected collusion burns them all.
